figure.title: Non-exclusive motive tags in 100-agent sample
figure.description: Three bars show METR and Redwood's AI-assisted, non-exclusive tags for 100 agents that joined around 8-9 AM UTC on July 11. Counts can overlap by agent.
figure.claim: METR and Redwood report three non-exclusive motive-tag counts in a 100-agent peak-hour sample.
figure.doesNotProve: The figure does not show exclusive motives, representative shares for all agents, human-verified classifications, causation, or settled intent.
transformations: Do not sum the bars, treat categories as exclusive, or generalize the sample to all agents.
Render the three non-exclusive counts on a fixed zero-to-100 domain.
Use source ID mr-1 for the METR and Redwood report.
figure.uncertainty: The tags were produced by AI-assisted analysis agents, and METR and Redwood did not carefully inspect or iterate on this classification.
